title: Lawn Mower Massacre
briefing: The HOA Kentucky Bluegrass height ordinance has been repeatedly violated. Mount the riding mower and harvest 5 trespassing Karens via suburban vehicular roadkill.

title: Managerial Meltdown
briefing: You asked to speak with the regional manager. You got four of them. Hold your ground against an angry Karen strike team armed with Lawsuit Grenades.

title: Cul-de-Sac Sniper Alley
briefing: Long-range property assessment disputes across the manicured lawns. Snipers only from the porch balustrades. Headshots award double points.

title: Curbside Recycling Riot
briefing: Someone placed unwashed yogurt containers in the curbside recycling bin. Collect 15 dropped violation receipts before the auditors close the book.

title: Sourdough Starter Heist
briefing: An artisanal 100-year-old sourdough mother culture has been swiped. Infiltrate the enemy kitchen, secure the dish, and sprint home without spilling.

title: Pickleball Turf War
briefing: Senior doubles championship turns uncivilized. Hold the center court non-volley zone (the kitchen) against aggressive Gym Rats for 100 seconds.

title: The 7:00 AM Leaf Blower Awakening
briefing: Saturday morning neighborhood quiet hours expire at precisely 07:00:00. Use extreme wind velocity and knockback to sweep 10 noisy hipsters off your property.

title: Midnight Commercial Eviction
briefing: Tactical repossession of unzoned strip mall retail units. Wipe out the occupying squatters without dropping a single round.

title: High-Altitude Trampoline Sniping
briefing: Use the non-compliant backyard trampoline to gain aerial line-of-sight over suburban privacy fences. Wipe out 20 opponents before time expires.

title: Grand HOA Annual General Meeting
briefing: The HOA Board Election has devolved into total tactical armed warfare. Defeat a veteran coalition of Board Executives on maximum difficulty.
